description: This Java class defines the entity 'MedicationDispense' within the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It models the detailed information related to the dispensing of medication to a patient, including references to related entities such as patient, encounter, drug, dispenser, and various attributes like dosage, timing, status, and substitution details. The class uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping to the 'medication_dispense' database table.

classes.name: MedicationDispense
classes.description: Represents a record of a medication being dispensed to a patient, including related contextual information such as patient, encounter, drug, dispenser, status, dosage, timing, and substitution details.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseId
methods.description: Returns the primary key ID of the medication dispense record.

methods.name: setMedicationDispenseId
methods.description: Sets the primary key ID for the medication dispense record.

methods.name: getPatient
methods.description: Retrieves the patient to whom the medication is dispensed.

methods.name: setPatient
methods.description: Assigns the patient to the dispense record.

methods.name: getEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves the encounter during which the dispensing occurred.

methods.name: setEncounter
methods.description: Sets the encounter for the dispensing event.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Gets the concept representing the medication's code.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Sets the concept representing the medication's code.

methods.name: getDrug
methods.description: Retrieves the drug information associated with the dispense.

methods.name: setDrug
methods.description: Sets the drug associated with the dispense.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the location where the dispensing occurred.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Sets the location of medication dispensing.

methods.name: getDispenser
methods.description: Retrieves the provider who dispensed the medication.

methods.name: setDispenser
methods.description: Sets the provider who dispensed the medication.

methods.name: getDrugOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the original drug order associated with this dispense.

methods.name: setDrugOrder
methods.description: Sets the drug order associated with this dispense.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status concept of the dispense.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status concept of the dispense.

methods.name: getStatusReason
methods.description: Retrieves the reason concept for the current status.

methods.name: setStatusReason
methods.description: Sets the reason for the current dispense status.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Retrieves the concept representing the type of dispense (e.g., Refill, Partial Fill).

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the concept representing the dispense type.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Retrieves the quantity of medication dispensed.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of medication dispensed.

methods.name: getQuantityUnits
methods.description: Retrieves the units of the dispensed quantity.

methods.name: setQuantityUnits
methods.description: Sets the units for the dispensed quantity.

methods.name: getDose
methods.description: Retrieves the dose amount.

methods.name: setDose
methods.description: Sets the dose amount.

methods.name: getDoseUnits
methods.description: Retrieves the units associated with the dose.

methods.name: setDoseUnits
methods.description: Sets the units for the dose.

methods.name: getRoute
methods.description: Retrieves the route of administration concept.

methods.name: setRoute
methods.description: Sets the route of administration.

methods.name: getFrequency
methods.description: Retrieves the frequency of medication administration.

methods.name: setFrequency
methods.description: Sets the frequency of medication administration.

methods.name: getAsNeeded
methods.description: Retrieves whether the medication is taken as needed.

methods.name: setAsNeeded
methods.description: Sets whether the medication is to be taken as needed.

methods.name: getDosingInstructions
methods.description: Retrieves the textual dosing instructions.

methods.name: setDosingInstructions
methods.description: Sets the textual dosing instructions.

methods.name: getDatePrepared
methods.description: Retrieves when the medication was prepared.

methods.name: setDatePrepared
methods.description: Sets the date when the medication was prepared.

methods.name: getDateHandedOver
methods.description: Retrieves when the medication was handed over to the patient.

methods.name: setDateHandedOver
methods.description: Sets the date when the medication was handed over.

methods.name: getWasSubstituted
methods.description: Checks whether substitution was made.

methods.name: setWasSubstituted
methods.description: Sets whether a substitution occurred.

methods.name: getSubstitutionType
methods.description: Retrieves the concept for substitution type.

methods.name: setSubstitutionType
methods.description: Sets the substitution type.

methods.name: getSubstitutionReason
methods.description: Retrieves the reason concept for substitution.

methods.name: setSubstitutionReason
methods.description: Sets the substitution reason.
